import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_GRID = 15;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 210;

    static int n, T;
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][] node_index = new int[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int node_count;
    static int zero_r, zero_c;
    static final int[] d_row = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] d_col = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static boolean in_bounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < n && grid1[r][c] >= '0' && grid1[r][c] <= '9';
    }

    static class Edge {
        int dest, capacity, reverse;
        Edge(int d, int cap, int rev) {
            dest = d;
            capacity = cap;
            reverse = rev;
        }
    }

    static Vector<Edge>[] graph = new Vector[MAX_NODES * 2];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES * 2];
    static int[] current = new int[MAX_NODES * 2];

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, graph[v].size()));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, graph[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void propagate(int r, int c) {
        if (grid2[r][c] != 0) {
            link(node_index[r][c] + node_count, 2 * node_count + 1, grid2[r][c] - '0');
        }
        if (grid1[r][c] == '0') return;

        link(0, node_index[r][c], grid1[r][c] - '0');
        if (grid2[r][c] != 0) {
            link(node_index[r][c], node_index[r][c] + node_count, 10);
        }

        int start_r = r, start_c = c;
        Queue<Integer> q1r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q1c = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2c = new LinkedList<>();
        q1r.add(r); q1c.add(c);
        q2r.add(zero_r); q2c.add(zero_c);

        int[][] dist1 = new int[n][n];
        int[][] dist2 = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                dist1[i][j] = -1;
                dist2[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        dist1[r][c] = 0;
        dist2[zero_r][zero_c] = 0;

        while (!q1r.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q1r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q1r.poll();
                int uc = q1c.poll();
                if (dist2[ur][uc] >= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + d_row[k], nc = uc + d_col[k];
                    if (in_bounds(nr, nc) && dist1[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        dist1[nr][nc] = dist1[ur][uc] + 1;
                        if (dist1[nr][nc] > T) break;
                        if (dist2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                        q1r.add(nr); q1c.add(nc);
                        if (grid2[nr][nc] != '0') {
                            link(node_index[start_r][start_c], node_index[nr][nc] + node_count, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            sz = q2r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q2r.poll();
                int uc = q2c.poll();
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + d_row[k], nc = uc + d_col[k];
                    if (in_bounds(nr, nc) && dist2[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        dist2[nr][nc] = dist2[ur][uc] + 1;
                        q2r.add(nr); q2c.add(nc);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean create_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        level[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.dest] == -1) {
                    level[e.dest] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.dest);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[2 * node_count + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int push_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == 2 * node_count + 1) return flow;
        for (int i = current[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            current[u] = i;
            Edge e = graph[u].get(i);
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.dest] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = push_flow(e.dest, Math.min(flow, e.capacity));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.capacity -= pushed;
                    graph[e.dest].get(e.reverse).capacity += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (create_levels()) {
            Arrays.fill(current, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = push_flow(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            grid1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            grid2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_GRID; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(node_index[i], -1);
        }
        node_count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zero_r = i; zero_c = j;
                } else if (in_bounds(i, j)) {
                    node_index[i][j] = ++node_count;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (in_bounds(i, j)) {
                    propagate(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_flow());
    }
}
